verdict.rationale: Codex supports triggering tasks from external events (GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Slack) and running non-interactive workflows, but there is no evidence of a user-defined rules engine that lets users specify arbitrary trigger conditions and automated actions (e.g., 'on X event, do Y') — this is closer to integration hooks than a rules/automation framework. missing for 10: evidence of a rules/trigger definition interface, conditional logic configuration, or event-to-action mapping system that users can author themselves.
